rationale: The agent verified the user correctly (name + zip matched to a single account) and obtained explicit confirmation before performing any writes. The water bottle return was submitted appropriately. However, the agent failed to complete the exchanges. The exchange tool returned an error (“non-delivered order cannot be exchanged”), but the agent gave an unsupported explanation (“order status changed to return requested and exchanges cannot be processed”), which contradicts the tool output and violates the policy against inventing facts. The agent also did not re-check order/item eligibility before committing to the exchanges. Because the requested exchanges were not completed and the explanation provided was not supported by tools, the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
